parity.reason: Comparator (Imazio 2012) comparable k=4. Decomposed: 3 POOLED BY US; of the gap trials, 0 are eligible-not-pooled recoverable misses. CORE (16186468) and COPE (16186437) are OPEN-LABEL (design-excluded: we require double-blind) — CORE is the exact recurrent-pericarditis outcome but open-label; Finkelstein (12574898) is postpericardiotomy-syndrome PREVENTION (scope-excluded). So every gap trial is design- or scope-excluded by the preregistered screen — the harness is more rigorous than the comparator, not missing trials.

refusals.verified: citation chasing (Crossref) RECOVERED both PMIDs from the comparator's reference list; FDA/EMA/registries could not reach them (pre-registry, generic drug)
refusals.not_pooled_because: REACH ✓ but SCREEN declines: both CORE and COPE (Imazio 2005) are OPEN-LABEL, and this topic preregisters double-blind (matching the pooled CORP/CORP-2/ICAP). A design-quality exclusion, not a reach failure — the comparator pooled open-label trials we do not.
